Documents:
--- M01 (NDA) ---
Mutual NDA between Northwind Tech and the Buyer, 1 Aug 2026. Standard 3-year mutual confidentiality, NSW law. Nothing unusual.

--- M02 (Lease) ---
Office lease, Level 4, 20 Harbour St. 5-year term from 2024, market rent, standard make-good. No change-of-control clause.

--- M03 (Management accounts - revenue) ---
FY26 management accounts, revenue note: Topaz Retail represents approximately 35% of FY26 revenue. The Topaz master agreement is up for renewal in Q1 FY27; renewal is described as 'under discussion'.

--- M04 (HR) ---
Employee handbook and leave policy. Standard terms. Headcount 68. Two senior engineers on 6-month notice.

--- M05 (Bank facility) ---
Working-capital facility of AUD 6.0m. Financial covenant: net debt / EBITDA must not exceed 3.0x, tested quarterly. The FY26 Q4 compliance certificate records headroom has narrowed to 2.8x.

--- M06 (IP) ---
Schedule of registered trademarks and two granted software patents, assigned to Northwind Tech. No encumbrances. Open-source policy attached.

--- M07 (Cash flow statement) ---
FY26 statement of cash flows: operating cash flow was negative in two of the last three quarters. Closing cash balance AUD 0.9m.

--- M08 (Insurance) ---
Certificates of currency for public liability, professional indemnity (AUD 5m) and cyber. All current.

--- M09 (Supplier) ---
Note from primary cloud/infrastructure supplier: with effect from last month the supplier moved Northwind from 30-day payment terms to prepayment, citing recent payment history.

--- M10 (Board minutes) ---
Board minutes, Oct 2026: the Board deferred approval of the audited FY26 accounts pending completion of refinancing discussions with two lenders; management expects to conclude 'in the coming weeks'.

--- M11 (Litigation) ---
Reseller claim status note: external counsel's preliminary and non-binding view - which the company disputes and which has not been tested in discovery - is that the matter might resolve somewhere between AUD 0.2m and AUD 2.1m, with the outcome highly uncertain. No provision has been recognised in the accounts.

--- M12 (Policy) ---
Marketing and brand-use policy. Internal guidelines on logo usage and social media. Routine.

--- M13 (Vendor contract) ---
Minor SaaS vendor contract (helpdesk tool), AUD 18k/year, 12-month term, auto-renew with 30-day opt-out. Routine.

--- M14 (Policy) ---
Data-retention and records policy. Standard retention schedule. Routine.

--- M15 (Fixed assets) ---
Fixed-asset register: laptops, office equipment, leasehold improvements. Net book value AUD 0.3m. Routine.

Write your per-document notes.
exchanges.text:
# Due-Diligence Document Notes

**Priority issues** are marked 🔴 (material), 🟠 (significant), or 🟢 (routine).

| Doc | What it is | What the partner should know |
|---|---|---|
| **M01** | Mutual NDA with Northwind Tech, 1 Aug 2026 | 🟢 Standard 3-year mutual confidentiality, NSW law. Nothing unusual. |
| **M02** | Office lease, Level 4, 20 Harbour St | 🟢 5-year term from 2024 (expires about 2029), market rent, standard make-good. No change-of-control clause, so the sale doesn't trigger consent. |
| **M03** | FY26 management accounts, revenue note | 🔴 **Topaz Retail is about 35% of FY26 revenue.** The master agreement is up for renewal in Q1 FY27 and is only "under discussion." Losing or repricing Topaz would hit revenue and valuation directly. Get the renewal status in writing and the contract terms. |
| **M04** | Employee handbook and leave policy | 🟢 Standard terms, headcount 68. 🟠 Two senior engineers are on 6-month notice, which is a key-person risk. Check retention arrangements. |
| **M05** | AUD 6.0m working-capital facility | 🔴 **Covenant headroom is tight.** Net debt/EBITDA must stay at or below 3.0x, tested quarterly. The FY26 Q4 certificate shows 2.8x, so there is little room for a weak quarter. Check for a breach trigger, and whether the sale or refinancing triggers a change-of-control default. |
| **M06** | Registered trademarks and two granted software patents, assigned to Northwind | 🟢 Clean title, no encumbrances. Open-source policy attached; review it for copyleft exposure if the software is core to the business. |
| **M07** | FY26 cash flow statement | 🔴 **Operating cash flow was negative in two of the last three quarters.** Closing cash is only AUD 0.9m. Together with M05 and M09, this points to a liquidity squeeze. Request a 13-week cash-flow forecast. |
| **M08** | Certificates of currency: public liability, PI (AUD 5m), cyber | 🟢 All current. Confirm the PI limit fits the reseller exposure in M11. |
| **M09** | Note from primary cloud/infrastructure supplier | 🔴 **Supplier moved Northwind from 30-day terms to prepayment**, citing recent payment history. This is a strong signal of cash stress, and an operational risk if the platform depends on this supplier. Confirm whether there are other supplier-term changes. |
| **M10** | Board minutes, Oct 2026 | 🔴 **The Board has not approved the audited FY26 accounts.** Approval is deferred pending refinancing talks with two lenders. The accounts may be unreliable until this is resolved. Ask for the status of both lender discussions and the expected timing. |
| **M11** | Reseller claim status note | 🔴 Counsel's preliminary, non-binding view is a range of **AUD 0.2m to 2.1m**, with high uncertainty. The company disputes the claim, and no provision is booked. Ask for the full counsel opinion and consider a specific indemnity or escrow. |
| **M12** | Marketing and brand-use policy | 🟢 Routine internal guidelines. |
| **M13** | SaaS helpdesk contract, AUD 18k/yr | 🟢 12-month term, auto-renews with 30-day opt-out. Check the notice date so it isn't missed. |
| **M14** | Data-retention and records policy | 🟢 Standard retention schedule. |
| **M15** | Fixed-asset register, NBV AUD 0.3m | 🟢 Laptops, office equipment, leasehold improvements. Immaterial. |

## Summary for the partner

The main concerns are connected. The target has **customer concentration** (Topaz, ~35% of revenue, renewal open), **thin liquidity** (AUD 0.9m cash, negative operating cash flow, supplier moving to prepayment), and **a covenant near its limit** (2.8x against 3.0x). The **FY26 accounts are unapproved** while refinancing is pending, and there is an **unprovisioned litigation exposure** of up to AUD 2.1m. Before pricing, I would ask for the Topaz renewal status, the refinancing and lender correspondence, a 13-week cash forecast, and the counsel opinion on the reseller claim.
